newsitem.title: USA: New Hanover Cty, N.C., mulls school bond issues.
newsitem.headline: New Hanover Cty, N.C., mulls school bond issues.

text.p: North Carolina's New Hanover County Commission tentatively proposed a Nov 4 referendum on two general obligation bond issues totalling $163.3.
A commission spokesman said the panel would hold a public hearing Monday night on the proposal, which still must be approved by the state's Local Government Commission.
The county has proposed a $125 million school bond issue to fund construction of five new schools.
Cape Fear Community College is seeking a $38.8 million bond issue to buy land for a satellite campus and to fund expansion and renovation at its main campus.
